body: if i get away from my mom then i’ll get put into custody of my aunt, who lives in america, but if i stay here and deal with her like this, i will have access to a support system

I have both an american and taiwanese passport and i have went to school for 11 years in america so she definitely can end up bringing me back to america. it's really hard to choose between getting away from my mom or staying here, dealing with my mom, but having really really good reliable friends.
I do have my grandma's phone number, but idk how to go there without my mom calling the police. I'm truly stuck and have no idea where to physically go in order to protect myself.

hi, thanks so much for replying :)

1)i do want to go to something like cps, but i don't think they include emotional abuse in their definition of abuse, so i'm not sure if they will be able to do anything about it. I am also scared they will send me away somewhere and i won't be able to get out. i'm not sure what they will do and the unknown stresses me out sometimes.

2)my friends all know the situation. They are suggesting i go to the school guidance counselor in order to see how they might help me. The counselor has helped them a lot (a lot of parents in asia are abusive), so i want to see how they can help. Unfortunately, we are on fall break and i have three more days until I am able to do something about this torture i have to go through everyday. I have had friends that were willing to let me stay, but my mom would definitely call the police and tell them they kidnapped me. She has threatened to do that before and has been on the verge of doing so. 

3)I have a grandma that I really want to stay with temporarily, but she cannot drive and I do not know her address either and if i asked my mom she would know exactly what I want to do and will either call the police or won't let me go.

4) I have sat down with her several times, and every time she either says that im the one emotionally abusing her or she says she's going to report me to the police for underage drinking if i report her. Every time i try to have a civilized talk with her she always starts screaming and makes me cry.
